name: matsugit
description: Edit Markdown and Org with matsugit document and slide previews in Codex.

interface.longDescription: A local editing workspace with source, rendered and split views, document and slide previews, explicit version-checked saving, and the matsugit authoring skill. Requires Node 22+, Python 3.10+ and Quarto. Does not publish documents.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open my Markdown document in the matsugit workspace with a split slide preview.
